exec: pm.test('created as DRAFT owned by caller', () => { pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('DRAFT'); pm.expect(b.organizerId).to.eql('usr-organizer-001'); });
pm.test('only capacity changed', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.capacity).to.eql(75); pm.expect(b.title).to.eql('Postman Event'); });

item.name: First student takes the only seat
Event summary as owner (capacity-1 event is full)

exec: pm.test('1 confirmed, 0 seats left', () => { pm.expect(b.confirmed).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.capacity).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.remainingSeats).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('totals add up', () => pm.expect(b.totalEvents).to.eql(b.draft + b.published + b.cancelled + b.completed));
